adminOnly: Only administrators can manage single sign-on and provisioning.

upgrade.title: Available on a higher plan
upgrade.sso: Single sign-on (SAML and OIDC) is available from the Business plan.
upgrade.scim: Automatic provisioning with SCIM is available on the Enterprise plan.
upgrade.euStrict: Strict EU residency (Claude only through AWS Bedrock in the EU) is available on the Enterprise plan.

sso.description: Single sign-on with your identity provider, automatic user provisioning and roles from their groups.
sso.connectionsDescription: Each connection serves one email domain. Users of that domain sign in from “Enterprise SSO”.
sso.dialogDescription: Set up the application in your identity provider with Messer's details and paste its details here.
sso.emptyDescription: Connect Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace or Okta with OIDC or SAML 2.0.
sso.name: Name
sso.domainHint: Emails of this domain will use this connection.
sso.defaultRoleHint: For people who are not in any mapped group.
sso.mappingCount: {count, plural, =0 {no mapped groups} one {# mapped group} other {# mapped groups}}
sso.enforceHint: Blocks password and social sign-in for these emails. Requires the verified domain.
sso.jitHint: Creates the account and the membership on first sign-in.
sso.testHint: Sign in at the provider without creating a session to check the configuration.
sso.deleteDescription: Users of this domain will no longer be able to sign in with SSO. Their accounts and memberships are kept.

oidcFields.clientSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one.
oidcFields.groupsClaimHint: Empty if the provider does not send groups.

samlFields.metadataHint: Paste the metadata XML and we will fill in the issuer, URL and certificate.
samlFields.certificateKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one.

testResult.title: Test result
testResult.subject: Subject
testResult.expired: The result has expired. Run the test again.

mappings.title: Groups and roles
mappings.description: Assign a role from the groups the provider sends. People in several groups get the highest role. The owner role is never assigned by group.
mappings.groupHint: Name or ID exactly as the provider sends it (Entra ID sends the object ID).
mappings.empty: No mapped groups: everyone gets the default role.

domains.title: Verified domains
domains.description: Prove you control the domain with a TXT record in your DNS. Required to sign in with SSO, require SSO and create users through SCIM.
domains.removeDescription: SSO connections for this domain will stop working until you verify it again.
domains.added: Domain added. Create the TXT record and press “Verify”.

scim.title: SCIM 2.0 provisioning
scim.description: Your identity provider creates, updates and deactivates users automatically. Deactivating someone removes their access and signs them out.
scim.newTokenDescription: Use this token as the “Bearer token” in your provider's SCIM settings.
scim.tokenCreated: Copy the token now: it will not be shown again.
scim.revokeDescription: The identity provider will no longer be able to sync users with this token.
scim.usersEmpty: No users have been provisioned yet.

residency.description: Where your organization's data is processed and how long it is kept.
residency.readOnly: Only administrators can change these settings.
residency.standardDescription: EU infrastructure. Claude models are called through the Anthropic API.
residency.strictDescription: Nothing leaves the EU: Claude only through AWS Bedrock in an EU region, local embeddings and email and voice providers with an EU region.
residency.regionHint: EU region where your data is processed.
residency.bedrockDescription: Model route for organizations with strict EU residency.
residency.bedrockMissing: AWS Bedrock is not configured in this installation (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY). With strict EU residency, models cannot be called until it is configured.
residency.providersDescription: Which providers your organization can use with its current residency.
residency.retentionDescription: Older traces and conversations are deleted automatically every hour.
residency.daysInvalid: Enter a number of days between 1 and 3650.
residency.neverPurged: Nothing has been deleted by retention yet.
residency.confirmStrictDescription: From now on models are called only through AWS Bedrock in the EU, embeddings run locally and providers without an EU region are blocked.

data.description: GDPR data subject rights: export or delete personal data verifiably.
data.mineDescription: Download everything Messer stores about you or delete your account in every organization.
data.deleteMineDescription: Your memberships, sessions, notifications, conversations and runs will be deleted and your references in the audit log anonymized. This cannot be undone.
data.memberDescription: Export or delete a person's data in this organization. If they belong to no other organization, their account is deleted too.
data.deleteMemberDescription: Their membership, notifications, conversations and runs in this organization will be deleted and their references anonymized. This cannot be undone.
data.orgDescription: A zip with one JSON table per data type, the knowledge tables, uploaded files and the projects' code.
data.requestsDescription: History of the organization's exports and deletions with their reports.
data.emptyDescription: Exports and deletions will appear here with their status.
data.adminHint: Administrators can export the organization or other members' data.
data.requested: Request recorded. We will email you when it finishes.

organization.name: Name
organization.deleteDescription: Every project, agent, workflow, knowledge base (including its tables), conversation, trace, file and record will be deleted verifiably. This cannot be undone.
organization.ownerOnly: Only an owner can delete the organization.
organization.deleteRequested: The deletion is in progress. You will receive the deletion report by email.

ssoError.title: We could not sign you in with SSO
ssoError.login: Sign in with email and password
ssoError.generic: The identity provider could not complete the sign-in. If it happens again, contact your organization's administrator.

codes.state_expired: The sign-in expired or was already used. Start again.
codes.state_mismatch: The response does not belong to this connection. Start again.
codes.connection_unavailable: The SSO connection does not exist or is disabled.
codes.plan_feature: The organization's plan does not include SSO.
codes.domain_not_verified: Your email domain is not verified by the organization.
codes.domain_mismatch: Your email does not belong to the domain configured for this connection.
codes.hosted_domain_mismatch: The Google account does not belong to the organization's Google Workspace domain.
codes.jit_disabled: Your account has not been set up in Messer. Ask your administrator for access.
codes.deprovisioned: Your access to this organization has been deactivated.
codes.user_blocked: Your account is blocked. Contact support.
codes.sso_required: Your organization requires single sign-on. Use “Enterprise SSO” with your company email.
codes.idp_unreachable: We could not reach the identity provider. Try again in a few minutes.
codes.invalid_signature: The response signature is not valid. Check the configured certificate.
codes.assertion_expired: The provider's response expired. Check the servers' clocks and try again.
codes.assertion_replayed: This response was already used. Start again.
codes.audience_mismatch: The response was not issued for Messer. Check the entity ID or the client ID.
codes.not_authenticated: Sign in to Messer to test the connection.
codes.forbidden: Only administrators can test the connection.
codes.missing_email: The provider did not send your email.
codes.email_unverified: The provider says your email is not verified.
